tolerances.pre_registered: research.md R3, fixed before the first run

comparison: surrogate-on-synthetic vs surrogate-on-real-panels; the evaluator is held constant so only the paths vary
caveat: the bootstrap resamples REAL blocks, so the body should match by construction. This is a plumbing-and-tails check, not validation of the harness's usefulness.
selection_rule: SHORTEST block length that passes calibration — the most resampling consistent with a faithful generator. NOT the best-calibrated value: KS falls monotonically with block length (0.0252 -> 0.0119 across 96..288), and at the limit L = series length every path IS the real series, so calibration would be perfect while the harness resampled nothing. Selecting by best calibration drives toward the degenerate case.
